title: kith does not build against current crate-jmap
description: kith uses unpinned path deps ../crate-jmap/*. crate-jmap moved ~780 commits since 2026-06-26; jmap_chat_types submodules are now private and message::SenderId is gone, so kith-core fails with 35 errors. Workaround in use (local, never commit): Cargo.toml path deps pointed at ~/GIT/crate-jmap-kith-pin checked out at 24f15707. Real fix: port kith-core to current crate-jmap or depend on a published version.
notes: 2026-10-30: workaround committed — crate-jmap pinned by git rev 24f15707 (public GitHub) so 'cargo install --git' works for IIW. Real fix (port kith-core to crate-jmap 0.4) still open.
